## Specific task description

Task instruction: Together lift the dark gray cooking kitchenpot up

Task description: The target is the dark-gray lidded pan slightly right of center, with handles on both sides. Lift the entire pan using both arms together.

Success criteria: The pot must be clearly raised and suspended above the table, with the left and right grippers near the grasp regions of its corresponding handles. Keep its opening up and body nearly upright without obvious tilt. A slight lift is insufficient.

## Execution tips

- Consider grasping a straight section of the outermost connecting rods on both handles, away from the corners. Adjust the opening to the rod thickness and nearby clearance, avoiding the open frame or pot wall.
- Before closing, confirm the fingers are actually on opposite sides of the solid rod with enough pad contact, rather than merely overlapping in the image or pressing on top with the fingertips.
- When lifting, raise both handles together as much as possible to reduce pot tilt. If one side slips, let the pot rest securely on the table before adjusting the grasp rather than releasing while suspended.
